item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded: The second image that was used in this article is non-compliant with the SCP wiki's license (CC BY-SA 3.0) as no source found indicates it has been released under Creative Commons. Thus, the image has been removed. The two images still present in this article are cc-compliant as the first is under Public Domain as seen on Wikimedia Commons, and the second is from the FBI according to this article, which means it's Public Domain.
